notes:
Inbound from legaltech SMB focused on contract review and confidential document search. Self-serve trial started 2026-02-15. Primary contact: Priya Rao (Head of Product). Key quote: "We cannot risk customer PII leaving US regions; we need per-call audit trails and retention controls".

Important points from discovery: short timeline to POC (2-3 weeks), low tolerance for ambiguous data residency, high cost sensitivity but willing to pay for compliance features. Uses Google Workspace; asks about SSO / SAML for team access.

Technical asks: examples of audit log schema (request id, timestamp, model, token counts, input hash), retention TTL options, KMS integration for customer-managed keys, and whether Redwood hosted API can guarantee US-only processing (not cross-region). Also asked about redaction and PII-hiding best practices for uploads.

Trial usage: ~20k tokens ingested for embeddings and search so far; tried text-generation for summary with concurrency ~5 users. Latency target mentioned: median <200ms for short summaries; throughput modest (10-20 qps peak).

Sales notes: Priya is pragmatic, technical. "If audit logs + US residency check out, we'll move to a paid dev seat and expand to 5 seats, then evaluate dedicated later." Wants sample SLA language and sample Data Processing Addendum (DPA).

Next: schedule a 45-min SE walkthrough focused on audit logs, retention, KMS integration, and region controls. Send tailored hosted API onboarding + security FAQ. Follow-up email thread: thread-1773abcd. Drive folder with POC materials: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Courtlyne-POC-Docs
use_case_summary: Courtlyne wants a hosted API to power confidential contract search and auto-summaries for SMB law firms. Primary needs: strong audit logging per API call, US-only data processing, SSO for team control, and KMS for encryption. Starting with embeddings and summarization; potential to expand to reranking and chat workflows.
latency_sla: median <200ms for short summarization calls; 95th pctile <400ms
concurrency_targets: 10-20 qps peak; initial POC with 5 concurrent users
cost_sensitivity: high - SMB budget, wants cost estimates and recommendations (batching/caching)
